title: Back to Newark: first wife and return to Atlantic City
summary: He recounts meeting his first wife in Newark and returning to Atlantic City after the season.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Newark, New Jersey. We were talking about how you got to Newark, New Jersey.
Well, I got to New York, Charley sent me to New York.
Yeah, Charley sent me to take his place. I had come up there and we was talking about the dope fiends.
And the first time I had seen a dope fiend.
And that's the first time I met my first wife, up there. And then when the season was over, I came back to Atlantic City. I played about three or four months there.
